notes.title: Dev Log #145 - Burn Off
notes.content:

[h1]Hey cyberjacks, robolovers, and synthwarriors,[/h1]

it's been some time since the last dev log. After working on the Boobie's Gate stuff, work is flowing again. I want to add some more renders before release, 300-400 is the goal here. 

Anthea will keep the new hairstyle which you all have already seen. It's just way more beautiful and fitting than the old one. And easier to work with too.

Zandra also gets the new hairstyle. She just wants to look professional when working in spaces with more people around than the security bunker at Plumbella Corp. Is it just me or does she look a bit more intimidating with it? Just a tiny bit, ya?

Still not sure if I should convert A-Z from G3 to G8. The advantages are obvious. Better and more assets to work with especially on the expression and item side(weapon mod). There is no appendage available for G3. Only the G8 got some Cyberpunk style assets.

Dunno why. )
Boobs look better now though.

TBH I'm still playing with the thought to convert Cary-June's model over from G3 to G8. The funtionality and amount of available assets, poses and new clothing is too damn tempting. 

That's it from me today.
Have fun

Oh, and there's 30% off right now.

notes.title: All night long ... Oh Yeaaah
notes.content:
[h1]Hey cyberjacks, tekkheads and streetlings,[/h1]
two other developers and I got together and joined our games into one affordable bundle. 

I proudly announce ...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549653/ad78d4564e66185c68d92d60ed8238ccdc460941.jpg[/img]

What's in it?
Get ready for a wild ride.

[h2]From the developer - Iskender -[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549653/c885a72a0ae343623519b4008aacd1c3497e20e8.png[/img]

In this Visual Novel, you step into the life of Banu, a determined woman living in the Middle East. After her ex-husband's tragic death, she remarries Kamil for the sake of their two-year-old daughter. As Banu's fate unfolds, you take control of her choices and navigate the complexities of love, relationships, and family, shaping her future.
[h2]
Alternate Existence by - MrKnobb -[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549653/9d6d22c1a3ae9c70ee17b91b346c1bbb39d50b4a.jpg[/img]

I am 22 years old. I have no memory of my parents as a child and no idea who or where they might be. I lived with an older woman when I was younger but even that didn’t last. She passed me on to foster care and I bounced from one family to another like a pinball until an incident caused that dismal little game to crash, to an end.
The day of the incident I left and never turned back.

Then one day a man gave me a way out of my crummy existence to a better life, or not?
What is the catch I keep asking myself to this better life? Let's find out...

[h2]Retrieving The Past STEAM Edition - MrKnobb -[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549653/41f419f76a3b1a055e8562ba68140e7d822e1390.jpg[/img]

You play as the handsome, fit, and capable Jensen Wenchester, a former Captain in Team 5 Infiltration Unit, Army Rangers, years ago, but now the successful owner of his own business, Wenchester Security Company. You have several homes, a successful company, and amazing colleagues, and that seemed like enough. But there's something happening and life is about to get complicated, and somehow it all ties back to the events forgotten in the past. Somehow you are going to need to uncover things so buried you didn't even know you'd forgotten them. Things are going to be exciting as you begin Retrieving The Past.

and
[h2]Cyberlinxxx by Baka_Energy_studios UPGRADE Edition[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549653/c5a012d886bfcc680c5527c49dd60d97963ce501.jpg[/img]

After the megacorporation's war fallout, the government relinquished control, granting megacorps extraterritorial rights. Meaning they can come up with any kind of law, restriction or freedom they deem necessary to achieve their goals.

This sparked the rise of Megacities, fuelled by advancements like AI, VR, gene editing, food printing, and advanced robotics, elevating life standards at a cost. In Arriaka's depths, you once manipulated DNA for false identities, served time, and earned a 2nd chance at Plumbella Corp. 

Your expertise birthed a potential cure for "Morbus Malkov," a coveted breakthrough for megacorporation factions. 

Now a target, they'll stop at nothing to seize your creation. But you refuse to surrender without a fight.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549653/fdd51a118030bc93d1dde2401c03b92239ebf78a.jpg[/img]


Whether you're looking to fuck, love, or just live out your wildest fantasies, this bundle has it all.

From flirty adventures to hilarious mishaps, it's the perfect way to heat up your gaming nights. Just make sure you got a fan nearby, things are about to get hot.

notes.title: Animations Yes or No?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549653/410609119033eeac391fb07413d62de754519753.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey cyberjacks, robolovers and skyraiders[/h1]

There's a question that has been popping up in my mind a lot in the last few weeks.

What about animations in visual novels?

I once played around with them last year and the results were awful. The program I'm using isn't user-friendly when it comes to making animations. You can do it, sure but it's not really made for that kind of thing. Some creators manage to make good animations with it but they are still far from what you would get when using software like Blender, Cascadeur, or Unreal Engine. 
For DAZ Studio, the one I'm using for rendering the images, there are animation blocks available from different creators. Some are better than others of course. Animations aren't easy to do. You have to account for a lot of limbs and other things wiggly to move properly and appropriately. 

But there's no denying that they can be very nice to look at and enrich the overall experience while playing an adult visual novel. Apart from animating explicit scenes, there can be car chases, people walking in the background, cars driving by or flying cars, a lively city background with light flashes from all kinds of different sources, and much more.

As much as they are nice to look at, they're time-consuming to make. 

Are they a must-have? Are they nice to have? Can you enjoy a visual novel without them?

notes.title: CYBERLINXXX - Developer Update #129
notes.content:
Hey there,
hope you're doing well.
I'm deep into rerendering the images for the VN.

What started as a simple rerender turned out to be a much needed rework of all renders up to v0.15. Except v016 because since the virtua game is intended to be a virtual recreation of the ingame reality it can look the way it does without changes.
Cary-June got a new black-golden dress and some repairing of her underlying UV map which caused cracks in her skin texture. You, as the player, never saw them but they were there and they annoyed the hell out of me.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/frXwSyY/Cary-June-old-copy.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/nPPTG22/Cary-June-new-copy.jpg[/img]

I'm also using the latest iterations of the tall amazonian Zandra and her smaller girlfriend Geena. The former got a new skin in, I think 0.14 or so. Her bigger frame caused the skin texture to look like a pimple swamp around her butt. Not anymore. Zandra was a real banger before but now she rocks.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/6XqH7kn/Zandra-old-copy.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/M9Q4p9b/Zandra-NEW-copy.jpg[/img]

Geena got some changes to her body and face and according to your reactions it made her just they way she was supposed to look. Petite, sexy and fierce. You will be surprised when you see her for the first time!

Trish's face got a slightly different nose and some changes to her mouth doesn't made her look "a bit intimidating" as some of you were putting it. Her blonde hair got a new shader and now it doesn't have that strange plastic shine anymore. She's gotten some Cyberlines under her eyes in orange-purple. Her lips were improved as well.
Easy to see that Trish benefitted the most.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/pJp9w3k/Trish-old-copy.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxTzhfz/Trish-new-copy.jpg[/img]

Asako will keep her tattoo which you have seen in the july wallpaper.

Keely remains unchanged, just like A-Z. Tried to convert her from G3 to G8(a technical description for the version of charactersG3 is a few years old and G8 was introduced 2 1/2 years ago. Neweset versions are so called G9 which I don't use because there are barely any cyberpunk or sci fi assets for those character models.)

The conversion made A-Z's face too ... smooth somehow. There must have been other changes happenning under the hood. Her smile turned out to be looking like someone stomped on her foot and she had to tolerate it. That change wasn't very usable so I throw the conversion over board.

Anthea also's gonna keep the tattoo that she had in an older wallpaper and maybe some back tatto.
Deanna got no changes until today. There could some but I have no idea what I could add or throw out to make her even more cute, so she will be her old self.

All those changes on top of updating to DAZ 21.05 with improved IRAY lighting(the render engine that produces the images) and many more other things are responsible that the images look way way better than 3 years back. 
Another setting that looks way better now.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/0sBrw8L/old03-copy.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/xgHSh8K/new03-copy.jpg[/img]

This is just a short glimpse on the many improvements [b]Cyberlinxxx[/b] is undergoing right now. There are still a lot of images left that will be rerendered and replaced in the next weeks. It is also one of the reasons, if not the biggest, that the VN will release in early access ... sonn.
That's it from me today.

Have fun
 Baka_Energy_studios
